mostWorthwhile.text: Exporting the collagen was most worthwhile because the sequence connected protein production inside a cell to supporting fibers outside it.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the finished fibers to the body felt predictable after the export sequence, although the cross-section clearly showed what still needed repair.

surprise.text: I was struck by the distinction between a closed surface and deeper tissue that is still remodeling and strengthening.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the ingredients and results gave each step a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it explored a different process with the same connections between cell work and tissue changes. This chapter was clear, though most combinations were predictable.
